caption:
📖 "What's the function of this sentence?" Here's how.

It's asking what job the sentence does for the passage. Look at the sentence before and after it.

✅ Ask: what would break if it disappeared?
✅ Gives an example of the claim before it.
✅ Introduces a view the author will challenge.
✅ Explains why something happened.
✅ Limits (qualifies) an earlier claim.
✅ Sets up the question the passage answers.
